_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Report of Manual Manifesting Activity
summary: The Report of Manual Manifesting Activity documents the status of contractors' efforts toward achieving contract objectives, identifying manual manifests entered into GATES.
use_relationship:
The Report of Manual Manifesting Activity documents the status of the contractors' effort towards achieving contract objectives. It identifies the manual manifests inputted into Global Air Transportation Execution System (GATES).
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report of Manual Manifesting Activity shall be in Microsoft Excel format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report of Manual Manifesting Activity shall contain the following:

children.title: Number of manifests entered into GATES
children.content: for each location that does not have GATES capability or acceptable electronic capability for cargo and passenger manifesting. Each location shall be identified by Area of Responsibility (AOR), to include:

children.title: Total tons of cargo manifested per location and AOR
Total passengers manifested per AOR, including space required and space available passengers
Number of manifests entered into GATES
children.content: for each GATES-capable location during system unavailability, to include:

children.title: Total tons of cargo manifested per location and AOR
Total passengers manifested per AOR, including space required and space available passengers
Number of manifests entered into GATES
children.content: for each deployed Web GATES location supported, to include:

children.title: Total tons of cargo manifested per location and AOR
Total passengers manifested per AOR, including space required and space available passengers
Cumulative totals of activities, identified above in 3.a through 3.c., throughout the current fiscal year.
